name: Vibrant Creative
description: Bold, energetic creative style with rich colors and dynamic compositions

color_palette.description: Vibrant multi-color palette, warm and cool contrast, energetic

visual_style.typography: mix of bold and script fonts, varied sizes

dos: Add subtle animations or motion blur
prompt_template: Create a {subject} in a vibrant creative style. Use a bold multi-color palette with warm reds/oranges (#FF6B6B, #FF8C42) and cool teals/purples (#4ECDC4, #6C5CE7) with bright yellows (#FFE66D). Design should be 3D with depth and layering, rich textures with gradients and subtle grain, high detail level with intricate embellishments. Composition should be dynamic and asymmetric with overlapping elements. Style: energetic, playful, inspiring, youthful. Include organic flowing shapes, playful illustrations, varied typography. DO: use bold saturated colors, create movement, layer elements, add texture. DON'T: use dull colors, static centered layouts, rigid geometric shapes, corporate styling.
